channels.name: CE_n
channels.purpose: Chip Enable, active-low. When LOW, target is selected; when HIGH the target enters low-power standby (if ready).

channels.name: CLE
channels.purpose: Command Latch Enable. When HIGH during WE_n rising edge, DQ is latched as a command opcode.

channels.name: ALE
channels.purpose: Address Latch Enable. When HIGH during WE_n rising edge, DQ is latched as an address byte.

channels.name: WE_n / CLK
channels.purpose: Write Enable (SDR) / Clock (NV-DDR). Rising edge latches commands/addresses/writes (SDR) or commands/addresses (NV-DDR family); shared pin.

channels.name: RE_n / RE_t / W/R_n
channels.purpose: Read Enable (SDR; falling edge = next read byte) / Read Enable True (NV-DDR3 differential) / Write-Read Direction (NV-DDR). Shared pin per data interface.

channels.name: RE_c
channels.purpose: Read Enable Complement (optional NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 differential).

channels.name: WP_n
channels.purpose: Write Protect, active-low. Disables Program / Erase when LOW.

channels.name: R/B_n
channels.purpose: Ready/Busy. LOW = at least one LUN operation in progress; requires external pull-up.

channels.name: DQ[7:0]
channels.purpose: 8-bit data bus. Carries opcode during CLE cycle, address byte during ALE cycle, write data, or read data.
channels.idle_level: Hi-Z when neither host nor device driving

channels.name: DQ[15:8]
channels.purpose: Upper 8 bits of 16-bit data bus; only SDR x16 packages.

channels.name: DQS / DQS_t
channels.purpose: Data Strobe True (NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3). Source-synchronous edges latch data on both polarities.
channels.idle_level: Held HIGH by host during NV-DDR2/3 Idle if ODT enabled

channels.name: DQS_c
channels.purpose: Data Strobe Complement (optional NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 differential).

channels.name: VREFQ
channels.purpose: External voltage reference for NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 single-ended input thresholds. Not used in SDR or NV-DDR.

channels.name: ZQ
channels.purpose: ZQ Calibration reference pin; tied to Vss through external RZQ (typ. 300 Ω ±1 %).

channels.name: ENi
channels.purpose: Enumeration input (CE_n pin reduction); daisy-chained from previous target's ENo.
channels.idle_level: LOW for first target, HIGH after enumeration

channels.name: ENo
channels.purpose: Enumeration output (CE_n pin reduction); daisy-chained to next target's ENi.

power_pins.name: VccQ
power_pins.purpose: I/O supply (separate from core; 3.3 V / 1.8 V / 1.2 V depending on data interface).

power_pins.name: Vpp
power_pins.purpose: Optional high-voltage power for improved Program / Erase efficiency.

power_pins.name: VDDi
power_pins.purpose: EZ NAND internal-regulator stabilizing capacitor pin (na on raw NAND).

global_signals.name: VREFQ
global_signals.purpose: Input reference voltage shared across DQ bus and DQS lines (NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3).

pin_sharing_map.description: WE_n pin carries CLK in NV-DDR mode; reverts to WE_n in NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3.
RE_n pin carries W/R_n in NV-DDR; RE_t in NV-DDR3 differential.
DQS only exists in NV-DDR family; single-ended NV-DDR, differential NV-DDR2/3.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_dq: 8-bit DQ bus carries one byte per cycle. Multi-byte fields (e.g., addresses, parameter-page values) are LSB-first on the wire (byte 0 first, byte N last).
ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_x16: x16 DQ bus carries 16-bit word per cycle; lower 8 bits on DQ[7:0], upper 8 bits on DQ[15:8].
ordering_rules.address_byte_order: Read / Program: column LSB byte first (C1), column MSB byte next (C2), row LSB byte (R1), row middle byte (R2), row MSB byte (R3). Erase: R1, R2, R3 only.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives all strobes; device drives R/B_n. CLE/ALE select cycle type; WE_n rising edge latches cmd/addr/write-data (SDR) or CLK rising edge latches cmd/addr (NV-DDR); RE_n falling edge or DQS edges drive read data. CE_n must be LOW for any traffic.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Address cycles depend on the immediately preceding command cycle. Data cycles depend on the most recent command + address sequence and the active data interface (SDR vs NV-DDR family). R/B_n LOW gates the host from issuing new commands (except Read Status, Reset).

handshake_pairs.name: CMD_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising edge → DQ latched as 8-bit opcode.

handshake_pairs.name: ADDR_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising edge → DQ latched as 8-bit address byte.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE_DATA_LATCH
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n rising edge (SDR) or DQS edge (NV-DDR family) → DQ latched as write byte.

handshake_pairs.name: READ_DATA_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n falling edge (SDR) or RE_t/RE_c + DQS edges (NV-DDR family) → device drives next read byte on DQ.

handshake_pairs.name: BUSY_INDICATION
handshake_pairs.rule: Any LUN starts an operation → R/B_n driven LOW. All LUNs ready → R/B_n released HIGH (external pull-up).

handshake_pairs.name: STATUS_POLL
handshake_pairs.rule: Host issues 70h (or 78h + 3 row addr); device drives status byte on next RE_n falling edge (SDR) or DQS edges (NV-DDR family).
